case_number: 2025 INSC 398; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025; SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 3802 OF 2024

parties.petitioner: The Chief Officer, Nagpur Housing and Area Development Board (A MHADA UNIT) and Others

summary: Delay in flat possession; deficiency in service; interest rate dispute; NCDRC awarded 9% p.a. interest on refund; High Court enhanced to 15% p.a.; Supreme Court restores NCDRC order; 15% held excessive; 9% deemed fair; reliance on Bangalore Development Authority v. Syndicate Bank; Rohit Chaudhary distinguished; appeal allowed; impugned High Court order set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Bangalore Development Authority v. Syndicate Bank, (2007) 6 SCC 711
Rohit Chaudhary and another v. Vipul Ltd., (2024) 1 SCC 8
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned High Court order set aside; NCDRC order restoring 9% p.a. interest on refund amount restored.
